lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five sub-parallel horizontal rows extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle, with cluster diameter and inter-node spacing increasing towards the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular clusters to form a rectangular grid of nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature along the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and a dark shadow cast on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, elongated fusiform feature with a high-luminance ventral margin is visible in the water column directly below the shark's ventral surface.
